commands.check: Check the security headers of the active view
commands.compare_environments: Compare the security headers across the environments

errors.environments: The comparison needs at least two environments (Settings > Project > Environments).
errors.headers_unavailable: The answer carries none of the headers this check reads, not even Date: they could not be read.
errors.no_page: No view shows a web page: open one or give a URL.
errors.redirect: The page redirects too often or to an address that is no web page.

cookie.prefix: The cookie {cookie} does not keep the rules of its {prefix} prefix: Secure, and for __Host- also Path=/ and no Domain.

cors.credentials: Access-Control-Allow-Origin * is sent together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.

csp.base_uri: The Content-Security-Policy sets no base-uri: add base-uri 'self' or 'none'.
csp.missing: The page sends no Content-Security-Policy: nothing limits where its scripts come from.
csp.missing_script_src: The Content-Security-Policy has no script-src or default-src: scripts are not restricted.
csp.object_src: The Content-Security-Policy sets no object-src (nor default-src): add object-src 'none'.
csp.unsafe: The Content-Security-Policy lets {keywords} work for scripts.
csp.wildcard: The Content-Security-Policy allows scripts from any source: {sources}.

frame.missing: Neither X-Frame-Options (DENY or SAMEORIGIN) nor CSP frame-ancestors keeps the page out of foreign frames.

hsts.missing: The HTTPS page sends no valid Strict-Transport-Security.
hsts.short: Strict-Transport-Security max-age is {maxAge, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}, under the minimum of {minAge}.

nosniff.missing: The page sends no X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

redirect.downgrade: The HTTPS page redirects to {url} over plain HTTP on the way: the connection can be read and changed there.

referrer.missing: The page sends no Referrer-Policy a browser knows.
referrer.unsafe: Referrer-Policy unsafe-url sends the full address of the page to every site, over HTTP too.

panel.empty: The project has fewer than two environments to compare.
panel.findings: {count, plural, =0 {No findings} one {# finding} other {# findings}}
panel.loading: Reading the page in each environment...
panel.same: The environments send the same security headers.

cookie.flags: A cookie without Secure, HttpOnly or SameSite
cookie.prefix: A cookie breaking the rules of its __Host- or __Secure- prefix

cors.credentials: Any origin allowed together with credentials

csp.unsafe: The Content-Security-Policy allows unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval
csp.wildcard: The Content-Security-Policy allows scripts from any source

hsts.short: A Strict-Transport-Security max-age under the minimum

redirect.downgrade: An HTTPS page that redirects to HTTP on the way

hstsMinAge.description: The smallest Strict-Transport-Security max-age, in seconds, that is not reported as too short.
hstsMinAge.help: An HTTPS page whose Strict-Transport-Security max-age is below this many seconds is reported. Example: 31536000, one year, which the HSTS preload list asks for.
hstsMinAge.label: Shortest HSTS max-age

tools.check: The security headers and cookies of a page's document (url, the active view's page without one): the values of the compared headers, each cookie's attributes (never its value), the page's project environment and the findings - CSP, HSTS, frame protection, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CORS with credentials, cookie flags and prefixes - with a count per severity.
tools.compare: The active view's page in each of the project's environments (environments names them, all without it): a table of header x environment, the rows that differ marked, each environment's findings, or why its page could not be read.
